Name: Alpha Squad
Overview: In the not so distant future, Earth is ruled by a military dictatorship known as The Alliance. They have put bounties on the heads of Clint, Jin, Lynx and Lackey, four mercenaries more commonly known as Alpha Squad. The player takes control of one member of Alpha Squad using a top-down perspective. He needs to fight different enemies whilst attempting to find out who in The Alliance has put a price on their heads and why. The game features a four-player co-operative mode for two to four people on a single Xbox 360 in split-screen, or over Xbox Live.
